description: This file contains test subroutines for the Recipe schema, including duplication, conversion from dish, and creation from recipe, utilizing a test database.

methods.name: duplicate
methods.description: Tests the duplication of a recipe, ensuring the clone has a different ID and the same number of ingredients.

methods.name: from_dish
methods.description: Tests creating a recipe from a dish, verifying ingredient quantities and units.

methods.name: from_recipe
methods.description: Tests creating a dish from a recipe, adjusting servings and verifying ingredient details.
